text:
If you want to kiss me... kiss

—I share your whims—.

But do not make my mouth captive...

kiss me softly on the eyes.


Do not tell me of the spells

of your kisses on the neck...

my curls are jealous,

caress my hair.


For your timely pampering,

if your eyes are words,

they will give me, one by one,

the thoughts you shape.


Put your hand between mine...

they will tremble like a canary

and we shall hear the symphonies

of some thousand-year-old love.


This is a dead night

beneath the astral roof.

The orchard is silent

as in a lethal dream.


It has a hue of alabaster

and a mystery of pagoda.

Look at the light of that star!

I have it all in my soul!


Silence... silence... hush!

Even the water barely runs,

beneath its green screen

the sand almost quiets...


Oh! what delicate perfume!

Do not kiss my red lips!

In the platinum night

kiss me softly on the eyes...

translation.title: In the Ear...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the repeated request for eye-kisses and the hushed platinum atmosphere.
